distinct_edge_pairs.note: distinct_edge_pairs x y u v: the unordered pairs {x, y} and {u, v} differ (neither orientation matches).

near_edge_pairs.note: near_edge_pairs x y u v: a shared vertex or an adjacent pair of endpoints, the eight disjuncts in order.

strong_pair_colourable.note: strong_pair_colourable G k: a symmetric map on all ordered vertex pairs into 'I_k separating two host edges whose pairs are distinct and near; total, so k = 0 only on the empty host; monotone in k.
